Title: MCP Search Tools Current State
Content: MemorySmith.App now exposes POST /api/memories/search/semantic for local semantic baseline ranking, POST /api/memories/search/hybrid for Lucene.NET plus semantic RRF ranking, and /mcp for HTTP JSON-RPC tool access. The MCP tools are memorysmith_search, memorysmith_semantic_search, memorysmith_hybrid_search, memorysmith_context_pack, and memorysmith_get. For larger KB workflows, prefer memorysmith_context_pack when an agent needs search results plus linked reference/conflict context in one response; it accepts query, ids, tags, status, limit, referenceDepth, maxContentChars, maxRecords, includeBacklinks, and format. Use format=json for structured parsing and the default markdown format for human-readable output. The tool reports warnings for missing roots, missing links, or omitted records after hitting maxRecords. .vscode/mcp.json points directly at http://localhost:5089/mcp. The implementation is covered by McpAndSemanticSearchTests, which use copied Data/Memories fixtures so the source project wiki remains stable.
